PWS children are often easy-going and affectionate, but personality problems often develop between 3 and 5 years of age, including temper tantrums, depression, stubbornness and obsessive compulsivity. panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Frontal clinical photograph of the patient showing multiple facial and body-contour manifestations explicitly attributed by the caption and in-text description to Prader-Willi syndrome. B: Profile clinical photograph from the same Prader-Willi case showing facial narrowing and facial adiposity; the caption associates the facial appearance and elevated BMI with the case. C: Clinical photograph explicitly captioned as demonstrating small hands, a characteristic manifestation of Prader-Willi syndrome. D: Clinical photograph explicitly captioned as demonstrating small feet, a characteristic manifestation of Prader-Willi syndrome.
